_comment: Non-secret SERVER config (dev defaults). SECRETS (JWT keys, DB/Redis creds, Discord secret) come from env — see datastores.*Env + .env, never inline here. Shared values the client also needs (e.g. MOVE_SPEED, intent types) live in packages/net-contract. Game-balance DATA (combat/mobs/loot) lives with the GameModule. Later: a zod-validated loader (@celestia/config) + per-env overrides (dev/staging/prod) that merge env secrets on top.
